item.title: Weekly GenAI Synthesis — Week 48, 2026 (Nov 23–28)
item.description:
Across 6 daily editions during Week 48, 2026 (Nov 23–28), The GenAI Briefing indexed 57 deduplicated technical developments. Frontier Labs & Ecosystem led the weekly ledger with 17 items (29.8% share), followed by World Models, Video & 3D at 12 items (21.1% share). Compared against the prior week, Coding Agents & DevTools expanded by +6% while Frontier Labs & Ecosystem contracted by -11%.

Top Engineering Cluster: Frontier Labs & Ecosystem (30% share, -11%)
